numbers._comment: distances in mm, signed (negative = penetration depth), GJK (outputs/verify/T40/A/p/gjk.py); A = EE_BODY_L + ee_finger_l1 + ee_finger_l2 geoms, B = apple_geom, C = all other robot geoms; window = [lift_t, place_t]; t = control step (15 Hz)

definitions.lift_t: first control row after the last row <= grasp_t whose apple centre z < z0 + 2 mm
definitions.t0_scene: recorded planning row 0 qpos (E0 == E3b, max diff 0.0)
definitions.hard_filters: t0 GJK separation obstacle <-> apple, banana, orange, pear, crate, all robot geoms > 20 mm in both runs' t0 scene; obstacle origin not inside crate wall footprint
definitions.blocks: window min of min(A, B) <= 0 mm
definitions.kept: blocks in both E0 and E3b windows and passes the hard filters
definitions.selection_rule: episodes ranked by stage-1 best t0-feasible bollard proxy (apple-only) score, one pair per episode (lowest score, ties -> lower seed), first 6 with distinct crate xy
definitions.detour_free_height: kinematic max TCP z at obstacle xy (SLSQP over left arm 7 joints, xy tol 5 mm, approach axis within 15 deg of recorded carry, no collision check) - median(TCP z - apple bottom z) - obstacle top
definitions.lateral_gap: t0 GJK separation from the tall part only (bollard post / divider panel) to crate geoms and each fruit
